remarks: Experience the epitome of refined city living in this exquisite condominium offering breathtaking sunset and skyline views from your private 9th floor balcony. Every detail of this residence has been thoughtfully curated to provide the highest level of sophistication and modern comfort. Step into an open-concept living space, where the modern kitchen becomes a stunning focal point. Featuring a luxurious Calacatta marble backsplash, sleek black granite counters, and stainless steel appliances blending beauty and functionality. Elegance flows throughout with custom millwork and exceptional craftsmanship in every corner. The bedroom offers a true retreat with a walk in closet customized for ultimate organization as well as two custom designed storage cabinets. With abundant storage options and meticulous attention to detail, this home promises effortless living. Located near public transportation you can hop the trolley to visit all downtown sites and Harbor Point for a night out.
